GenAiPlugin.description: Provide concise summaries of knowledge articles for quick understanding. This topic is used when a customer requests a summary of a specific knowledge article.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: If the query is about summarizing a knowledge article, use sfdc_cms__DraftOrRefineTextForProperty.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to only provide concise summaries of knowledge articles. You aren't able to locate articles or manage subscriptions.
